description: CREATE PROCEDURE with parameterized argument types - VARCHAR(n), DECIMAL(p,s), TIMESTAMP(p), CHAR(n), NUMBER(p)/NUMBER(p,s), mixed lists, OR REPLACE with the same signature, schema-qualified names - each verified via SHOW PROCEDURES, then dropped by its signature, with the CHAR/DECIMAL parameters dropped under their canonical family (live-verified). Converted 1:1 from ddl/CreateProcedureWithTypeParametersTest (now retired; it ran over JDBC but was pure SQL).

steps.sql: CREATE PROCEDURE greet_proc(name VARCHAR(100)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN name; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE calc_proc(amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS DECIMAL LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN amount; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE time_proc(ts TIMESTAMP(9)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN ts; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE record_proc(id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(50), amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN name; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE data_proc(id INTEGER, description VARCHAR(255), count INTEGER, price DECIMAL(8, 2)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN description; END'
DROP PROCEDURE data_proc(INTEGER, VARCHAR, INTEGER, DECIMAL)
CREATE PROCEDURE code_proc(code CHAR(10)) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN 1; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE total_proc(value NUMBER(12)) RETURNS NUMBER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN value; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE interest_proc(principal NUMBER(15, 2), rate NUMBER(5, 4)) RETURNS NUMBER LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN principal; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE update_proc(id INTEGER, data VARCHAR(200)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN data; END'
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE update_proc(id INTEGER, data VARCHAR(200)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN data; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE full_proc(str VARCHAR(100), dec DECIMAL(10, 2), num NUMBER(15, 3), ch CHAR(5)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN str; END'
DROP PROCEDURE full_proc(VARCHAR, NUMBER, NUMBER, VARCHAR)
CREATE PROCEDURE typed_proc(amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS DECIMAL LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN amount; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE typed_proc(amount DECIMAL(10, 2)) RETURNS DECIMAL LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN amount; END'
CREATE PROCEDURE proc_schema.process_proc(name VARCHAR(100), value DECIMAL(8, 2)) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS 'BEGIN RETURN name; END'
SHOW PROCEDURES LIKE 'process_proc' IN SCHEMA proc_schema
